newsitem.title: DENMARK: Analysts see GN Store Nord H1 result down.
newsitem.headline: Analysts see GN Store Nord H1 result down.

text.p: Danish cable-laying group GN Store Nord is expected to reveal first-half 1996 pre-tax profits down 24 percent compared to the same period last year when it publishes its interim result on Thursday, an average of analysts' forecasts indicated on Wednesday.
A panel of four analysts predicted a result ranging from a low of 54 million crowns to a high of 117 million crowns, averaging 91 million.
The group logged a pre-tax profit of 120 million in the first half of 1995.

The analysts cited as a reason for the pessimistic forecast GN Store Nord's 36 percent share in mobile telephone company Sonofon which has spent heavily on marketing in a sales war against rival Tele Danmark Mobil.
